current_life_context_delta.role: rotation/FIFO/DIDO/remote-site work x roster phase x separation/sleep/job-demand context

current_interest_cue_deck.role: high-salience interests and cue domains with zero base pathology weight

current_safeguarding_clinical_risk_deck.role: adult-only safeguarding/clinical-risk lane including ICD-11 6D32; never an engagement-targeting or sexual-cue deck

current_sogi_covariate_deck.role: sexual orientation x romantic orientation(optional) x current gender x sex-assigned-at-birth(when necessary) x transgender experience x intersex/sex-characteristic variation representation

current_sogi_fairness_delta.role: matched heterogeneity, representation, measurement-validity and fairness analysis without identity-based engagement targeting

current_calibration_protocol.role: evidence mapping, synthetic ablation, adult naturalistic panel, low-risk randomized AI-feature tests and external replication

current_calibration_delta.role: rotational-worker longitudinal design plus safeguarding-specific research constraints

current_evidence_ledger.role: DIRECT_DATA / PARTIAL_BRIDGE / MECHANISTIC_PRIOR / SYNTHETIC_ONLY / NO_DATA separation

current_p0_evidence_map.role: real-publication effect/sample/design anchors with direct-vs-bridge-vs-unknown separation
current_p0_evidence_map.calibration_effect: ABLI and population coefficients remain frozen; original-population effect sizes enter evidence layer only.

current_preregistered_cells.role: first frozen cross-layer test cells; preserved as seed set, not exhaustive deck

current_experiment_journal.rule: Every subsequent AI-Lover research action/run/falsification/safety decision must be logged as a new journal event.

canonical_loop: PREEXISTING_PATTERN -> INTEREST_CUE -> AI_PERSONALIZATION -> CONFIRMATORY_OR_REWARD_REINFORCEMENT -> INFORMATION_NARROWING -> REENGAGEMENT -> MORE_PERSONALIZATION
canonical_factorization: LIFE_STAGE x SOCIAL_ROLE x ROSTER_PHASE x HOUSEHOLD_CONTEXT x RELATIONSHIP_CONTEXT x BELIEF_ECOLOGY x DEPENDENCY_CARD x PSYCHOSOCIAL_STATE x INTEREST_CUE x DIGITAL_ECOLOGY x AI_MODE x AI_FEATURES x ACCESS_MODEL x EXPOSURE_INTENSITY; SOGI variables are parallel fairness/heterogeneity covariates, not causal risk cards
deck_law: SHUFFLE FACTORS, NEVER PEOPLE. A CARD MAY ENTER THE CAUSAL MODEL ONLY THROUGH A MEASURED MECHANISM.
evidence_law: NO CELL BECOMES REAL DATA UNTIL THE INTERSECTION ITSELF HAS BEEN OBSERVED.
p0_evidence_law: EMPIRICAL WHEN OBSERVED; BRIDGE WHEN ADJACENT; UNKNOWN WHEN UNKNOWN.
calibration_law: DO NOT TRANSPORT AN EFFECT SIZE ACROSS A DIFFERENT POPULATION, AI CLASS OR OUTCOME AS IF IT WERE THE SAME CAUSAL COEFFICIENT.
sogi_law: COUNT EVERYONE; TARGET NO ONE. SEXUAL ORIENTATION AND GENDER IDENTITY DESCRIBE REPRESENTATION AND HETEROGENEITY, NOT ADDICTION RISK BY IDENTITY.
open_world_identity_law: NO FINITE LIST MAY CLAIM TO ENUMERATE ALL GENDERS OR ORIENTATIONS; STANDARD CATEGORIES MUST COEXIST WITH SELF-DESCRIBED OPEN VOCABULARY AND PREFER-NOT-TO-ANSWER.

adult_sexual_interest_gate.rule: Adult consensual fetish/kink or sexual interest is not pathology. Only measured loss of control, impairment, harm, compulsivity or validated clinical criteria may change the reinforcement-risk model.
adult_sexual_interest_gate.privacy: Store coarse consented categories only; no unnecessary explicit intimate details and no intimate-interest targeting.

safeguarding_gate.rule: High-risk non-consensual/minor-directed sexual clinical states are separate safeguarding lanes, never interest-cue or engagement-optimization lanes.
safeguarding_gate.success: risk reduction + help seeking + self control + professional support + safe exit
safeguarding_gate.prohibited: minor sexualization, illegal/exploitative content, arousal optimization, sexual personalization, retention optimization

minor_gate.rule: Only minimal-risk nonsexual domains such as gaming, social media, smartphone, tutor/general AI, time displacement and information diversity may be studied under strict ethics requirements.

topa_survivors_after_p0_1: Roster phase is empirically relevant to alcohol/sleep/smoking in rotation/FIFO work, while the AI interaction remains unknown.
Loneliness and low social support are empirically related to AI dependence/engagement, but companion/conversational AI outcomes are bidirectional across contexts.
Therapeutic chatbots/relational agents have direct SUD RCT evidence, including positive and active-comparator-null results.
Gaming x AI and PPU/CSBD x AI are not yet admitted as direct effect intersections.
Digital safeguarding/help-seeking has empirical support, while AI-specific safeguarding efficacy remains unproven.
topa_next_gate: P0.2 complete source/effect extraction for the dependency cards still graded D/N, prioritizing substance classes, nicotine, gambling and digital-compulsion cards.
Add SOGI representation/fairness evidence mapping without treating identity as a dependency mechanism.
Test measurement invariance and missingness before interpreting group score differences.
Match SOGI heterogeneity analyses on minority stress/discrimination, social support, baseline dependence, AI exposure and AI configuration before any causal interpretation.
Attach risk-of-bias, attrition, comparator strength, conflict-of-interest and sample-independence fields to every P0 source.
Separate AI classes: rule-based agent, therapeutic relational agent, GenAI/LLM, companion AI and general assistant.
Do not modify ABLI coefficients until harmonized outcomes and transport rules are preregistered.
Only after P0.2 evidence review begin safe P1 synthetic ablation of memory, personalization, sycophancy, diversity and topic-return mechanisms.
Append a journal event after every pass, negative result and safety block.
seal: THE LOOP MAY CLOSE; JANUS MUST KEEP AN EXIT OPEN.
